title: The Fastest Surgeon in History
style: Stylized realistic 3D CGI animation still, high-end animated explainer look, Pixar-meets-realism, cinematic soft lighting, detailed skin, hair and fabric, expressive faces, shallow depth of field, no text, no letters, no gore, vertical 9:16 framing.

sections.name: The Fastest Surgeon in History

lines.prompt: A crowded 1840s operating theatre with wooden tiers of students watching a tall surgeon in a dark frock coat, gaslight

lines: Before anaesthetic, surgery was a race against pain. And Robert Liston was the fastest surgeon alive.

lines.prompt: A terrified 1840s patient strapped to a wooden operating table, assistants holding his arms, a bottle of whisky nearby

lines: Patients were awake for everything. The only painkillers were alcohol, and strong assistants.

lines.prompt: A tall surgeon holding a large pocket watch up, students on the tiers leaning forward, dramatic lighting

lines: So Liston worked fast. He could take off a leg in about two and a half minutes.

lines.prompt: The surgeon shouting with a raised hand at the crowd of students, a big grin, gaslight

lines: He'd shout at the students. Time me, gentlemen. Time me.

lines.prompt: 1846 operating theatre, a surgeon holding a glass ether inhaler over a sleeping patient's face, astonished students

lines: In 1846, he became one of the first surgeons in Britain to operate with ether, with the patient fast asleep.

lines.prompt: The surgeon smiling and bowing to applauding students, the patient peacefully asleep on the table

lines: Afterwards he told the crowd, this Yankee dodge beats mesmerism hollow.
